descriptionByLocale.en:
Graf + Cie AG, the world’s leading supplier of clothing and combs for carding and combing machines for short-stack and long-stack spinning as well as for manufacturers and mechanical engineers for the production of textile composites (Nonwovens), is a subsidiary of the Rieter Group. Headquartered in Rapperswil, Switzerland, Graf offers added value to its customers with highly developed industry knowledge, innovative solutions, excellent after-sales services and a global presence. The core competencies of the company lie in the production of flexible flat clothing, all-steel clothing for carding and carding, in know-how in metallurgy and in precise steel processing. Graf’s high production depth is the foundation for the superior quality of products and services.

You have power, are versatile and service- and goal-oriented? You enjoy working in a team, are curious and always find innovative ways to reach your goal? Then you fit perfectly with us and can strengthen our team as

The position

• Overall responsibility for achieving sales and earnings targets in sales within our international group

• Strategic and operational management of the sales, service and marketing teams in Switzerland and at our international locations

• Professional management and support of our international sales partners

• Building and maintaining long-term relationships with key customers in Germany and abroad

• Planning, implementation and continuous development of sales and marketing activities

This is what they bring with them.

• Completed technical studies, ideally in the field of textile machinery construction or a related discipline

• Several years of experience in the international B2B sales of technical products

• Strong customer orientation as well as a secure presence in dealing with international business partners

• Negotiation security and experience in establishing and maintaining long-term customer relationships

• Experience in the further development of sales, service or marketing processes

• Secure use of common office tools and digital work equipment

• Confident knowledge of English, Spanish is an advantage

• Willingness to travel internationally (about 50%)

• Team-oriented personality with intercultural competence

Our promises

• An international working environment with tradition and future

• A varied activity in an innovative environment with a lot of personal responsibility

• Attractive development opportunities and fair employment conditions

• A dedicated team characterized by respect, openness and good cooperation

We are looking for people with ideas, courage and energy. With us you will find a world of diversity, mutual respect and cooperation. Become part of our team and send us your online application.

Area: Sales

Level: Managers
